sites.note: bytes 0x1a39188..8b: SHD, CAMNR, YAP, LIM28 flags; CAMNR (0x1a39189) 0 to 1. The other three stay 0

summary.stage: CamNrs (level 2), its Nr register group 0x7000-0x787c and sub-block word 0x1fc
summary.effect: CAMNRS::job_YC_CalcParam 0x339d78 zeroes the stage's enable bytes at each picture calculation; the movie path 0x8440d2 -> 0x87857e writes them: registers 0x7000, 0x7004, 0x700c = 0, 0x1fc = bit 26 only (emulated)
summary.scope: every picture the calculation serves until a cold boot (movie and live view; stills too, which have their own develop path 0x33b548 as well)
summary.when: any time; the calculation reads the byte each time it runs (exposure and setting changes)
summary.not_known: the camera's value of the word (zero from start-up by the code; never read); whether the host ever sends command 0xf6 (it would overwrite the byte); what the hardware does with all enables at 0
